visit_status_history_canceled_source_che.name: visit_status_history_canceled_source_check
visit_status_history_canceled_source_che.value: ("visit_status_history"."to_status" <> 'CANCELED' or "visit_status_history"."cancellation_source" is not null) and ("visit_status_history"."to_status" = 'CANCELED' or "visit_status_history"."cancellation_source" is null)

visit_status_history_job_cancellation_ch.name: visit_status_history_job_cancellation_check
visit_status_history_job_cancellation_ch.value: "visit_status_history"."cancellation_source" is distinct from 'JOB_CANCELLATION' or "visit_status_history"."job_status_history_id" is not null

visit_technician_history_assigned_check.name: visit_technician_history_assigned_check
visit_technician_history_assigned_check.value: "visit_technician_history"."event" <> 'ASSIGNED' or ("visit_technician_history"."role_code" is not null and "visit_technician_history"."previous_role_code" is null)

visit_technician_history_removed_check.name: visit_technician_history_removed_check
visit_technician_history_removed_check.value: "visit_technician_history"."event" <> 'REMOVED' or ("visit_technician_history"."role_code" is null and "visit_technician_history"."previous_role_code" is not null)

visit_technician_history_role_changed_ch.name: visit_technician_history_role_changed_check
visit_technician_history_role_changed_ch.value: "visit_technician_history"."event" <> 'ROLE_CHANGED' or ("visit_technician_history"."role_code" is not null and "visit_technician_history"."previous_role_code" is not null and "visit_technician_history"."role_code" <> "visit_technician_history"."previous_role_code")

visits_scheduled_requirements_check.name: visits_scheduled_requirements_check
visits_scheduled_requirements_check.value: "visits"."status" <> 'SCHEDULED' or ("visits"."property_id" is not null and "visits"."scheduled_start" is not null and "visits"."scheduled_end" is not null)

visits_completed_outcome_check.name: visits_completed_outcome_check
visits_completed_outcome_check.value: "visits"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' or ("visits"."outcome_code" is not null and "visits"."outcome_summary" is not null)
